tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels; also the inset ground of segmented controls and inputs.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels, stat tiles and chart surfaces. The surface most text sits on.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Wells inside a panel: notices, hovered table rows, share-bar tracks, secondary buttons, count pills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, table rules, dividers. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: button and input borders, the active nav tab, table total rules. At least 3:1 on bg, panel and raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, panel and raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, panel and raised: captions, column headers, coin suffixes, axis labels.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold fill: the primary button, selection indicators, slider tracks. Never text; use accent-ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text on bg, panel and raised: the active nav tab, selected segment, stat tile icons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected segment or a selected table row.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: links and the estimate marker (values the ledger computes rather than reads, such as quest rewards). Text on bg, panel and raised.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Better for profit: income up or spending down. Text on panel and gain-soft; always paired with an arrow and a sign.

tokens.name: gain-soft
tokens.usage: Delta chip ground behind gain text.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Worse for profit: income down or spending up. Text on panel and loss-soft; always paired with an arrow and a sign.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Delta chip ground behind loss text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: series-sundries
tokens.usage: Chart colour for the Sundries shop category. Slot 1 of the validated stack order.

tokens.name: series-potion
tokens.usage: Chart colour for the Potion shop category. Slot 2.

tokens.name: series-beverage
tokens.usage: Chart colour for the Beverage shop category. Slot 3.

tokens.name: series-jewelry
tokens.usage: Chart colour for the Jewelry shop category. Slot 4.

tokens.name: series-relic
tokens.usage: Chart colour for the Relic shop category. Slot 5.

tokens.name: series-orders
tokens.usage: Chart colour for Order income (dispatches). Slot 6.

tokens.name: series-quests
tokens.usage: Chart colour for Quest rewards. Slot 7.

tokens.name: series-purchasing
tokens.usage: Chart colour for Purchasing (restock spending), drawn below the baseline. Deliberately neutral: spending is not a category of income.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: The page's one headline: the day being read.

styles.name: type-kpi
styles.usage: The value in a stat tile.

styles.name: type-heading
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a panel and table total rows.

styles.name: type-body
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, medium buttons.

styles.name: type-small
styles.usage: Notices, legends, small buttons and segments.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Column headers, stat tile labels, captions.

styles.name: type-eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels above a panel title. Always uppercase (add the uppercase class).

styles.name: type-micro
styles.usage: Delta chips, count pills, chart axis ticks, share percentages.

styles.name: type-code
styles.usage: Internal item IDs, file paths and save names shown as data.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The Tailwind spacing unit: p-1 = 4px, gap-3 = 12px. Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between controls in a toolbar; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between stat tiles; panel header to body.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding and table cell inset.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between panels in a page column.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between page regions (header to content).

tokens.name: corner-xs
tokens.usage: Delta chips, legend swatches, item icon tiles.

tokens.name: corner-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: corner-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav tabs, notices.

tokens.name: corner-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and stat tiles.

tokens.name: corner-pill
tokens.usage: Count pills and share-bar tracks.

shadow.note: Surfaces are separated by borders, not shadows. Shadows only lift things that float over the page.

tokens.name: elevation-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and chart hover cards.

tokens.name: elevation-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the day detail side panel.
